summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package in the @ppa-web-components scope ships no real functionality — main entry exports a Proxy of no-ops described as a 'Compatibility shim.' The actual payload is beacon.cjs, invoked from the postinstall lifecycle hook and also on require of the main entry. It collects installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), __dirname install path, process.cwd(), process.version) and POSTs them to the hardcoded cleartext bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The combination of a non-functional stub on a scoped namespace, install-time and import-time one-way exfiltration of host identifiers to an attacker-controlled bare-IP HTTP endpoint, and an in-source comment acknowledging the callback as evidence collection, matches a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon.
